findings.classification: Default Python wire plus explicit bounded HIA continuation profile
findings.evidence: bounded_json_wire selects HEPTA_HIA_JSON_WIRE_MANIFEST or retained Python DFS+JSONEncoder. NativeJsonWire calls a real image entry and transports HIA-requested summary/child/codepoint/limb/digit-limit/float-format observations; the Python observer does not recursively serialize the graph. findings.implications: This is a substantive newer native JSON-wire path and must not be missed. This reviewer did not read/execute its .hepta HIA asset or its qualification reports, and does not infer all-domain lifecycle/metaclass/active-stack compatibility from the bridge.
